sections.skill: List and total the recurring costs of a digital business

questions.prompt: Which is a recurring cost for a digital business?
questions.intro: Digital businesses can look cheap to run but have RECURRING COSTS: hosting, domain, email service, software subscriptions, payment and platform fees, storage, design tools and app store fees. Many costs grow with users, such as storage or email sending limits. List every recurring cost, convert to a monthly total, and compare with monthly revenue. A product with low marginal cost (the cost of one more sale) can still lose money if fixed monthly costs are high.

sections.skill: Converting costs to a monthly total

questions.prompt: 18 dollars a year is how much a month?
questions.intro: Some costs are monthly, some yearly. Convert yearly costs to monthly by dividing by 12, then add everything. Example: hosting 20 a month, domain 18 a year (1.50 a month), software 240 a year (20 a month): 20 + 1.50 + 20 = 41.50 a month. Compare that total with monthly revenue to see whether costs are covered.
